name: How is a vanity top and sink sealed and secured?

mainEntity.name: How is a vanity top and sink sealed and secured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a vanity top involves dry-fitting the stone or solid surface, securing it to the base, and sealing all adjoining seams. After the base cabinet is leveled and anchored to the wall studs, a bead of silicone adhesive is applied along the top frame to set the countertop. If an undermount sink is included, it is mounted securely beneath the stone cutout with epoxy and support clips. Once the countertop is set, color-matched silicone caulk is applied along the wall and backsplash joints to block moisture from seeping behind the cabinet and damaging drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: The top is secured to the leveled cabinet with silicone adhesive, undermount sinks are bracketed beneath the counter, and perimeter edges are sealed with waterproof caulk.
